title: Whitefish fillets with herb potatoes and spinach
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18–20 minutes.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper and dust very lightly with flour.
Fry skin side down in half the butter for 3 minutes, turn and cook for 1 more minute, then drizzle with lemon juice.
Wilt the spinach with chopped garlic in the remaining butter.
Toss the potatoes with the chopped herbs and serve with the fish and spinach.
